{
  "summary": "The function processes input bytes using a 32-round hashing algorithm, writes 8 bytes to output, and returns success or error based on input size constraints.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_05",
  "algorithm": "MurmurHash3 32-bit",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [

      "id": "_0001",

      "text": "Returns 0x10000000000000000 when len < 0x18 or out_cap < 8.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x10000000000000000"],

      "id": "_0002",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns 8 when len >= 0x18 and out_cap >= 8.",
      "asserted_values": ["8"],
      "confidence": 0.99

    {
      "id": "_0003",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Writes 8 bytes to out[0..7] from 32-bit values v0 and v1.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.99
    },
    {
      "id": "_0004",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0x9e3779b9 in the hash calculation.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x9e3779b9"],
      "confidence": 0.99
    },
    {
      "id": "_0005",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Executes a 32-round loop with fixed iteration count.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x20"],
      "confidence": 0.99
    },
    {
      "id": "_0006",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Computes a 32-bit hash using a variant of MurmurHash3 algorithm.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_05(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t v0, v1;\n  uint32_t s = 0;\n  uint32_t r;\n\n  if (len < 0x18 || out_cap < 8) {\n    return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n  }\n\n  v0 = *(const uint32_t *)(in);\n  v1 = *(const uint32_t *)(in + 4);\n\n  for (r = 0; r < 0x20; r++) {\n    s += 0x9e3779b9;\n    v0 = v0 + ( *(const int *)(in + 0xc) + (v1 >> 5) ^ v1 * 0x10 + *(const int *)(in + 8) ^ s + v1 );\n    v1 = v1 + ( *(const int *)(in + 0x14) + (v0 >> 5) ^ v0 * 0x10 + *(const int *)(in + 0x10) ^ s + v0 );\n  }\n\n  out[0] = (uint8_t)v0;\n  out[1] = (uint8_t)(v0 >> 8);\n  out[2] = (uint8_t)(v0 >> 0x10);\n  out[3] = (uint8_t)(v0 >> 0x18);\n  out[4] = (uint8_t)v1;\n  out[5] = (uint8_t)(v1 >> 8);\n  out[6] = (uint8_t)(v1 >> 0x10);\n  out[7] = (uint8_t)(v1 >> 0x18);\n\n  return 8;\n}"
}
